content: We need to find a retrosynthetic template for carbonyl-ene reaction. The forward reaction: carbonyl + alkene -> new C-C bond, C=O to C-O, C=C to C-C, forming alcohol and five-membered ring. So retrosynthesis: break the C-O bond (alcohol) to carbonyl, break C-C bond to alkene. So we need a template that does carbonyl-ene. Use search with functional_groups_broken: ["ketones"], functional_groups_formed: ["aliphatic hydroxyls"], bonds_broken: maybe "C=O", "C-C"? But bonds format expects "X-Y" where X and Y are atomic numbers? Actually bond types like "6-6" meaning carbon-carbon single bond? For broken double bond maybe "6-6"? Not sure. Could just search without bond criteria. Use functional groups only.
